description: This file defines data structures, classes, and functions for modeling the input/output signatures of export graphs in PyTorch, including argument specifications, input/output kinds, and signature transformations.

classes.name: TensorArgument
classes.description: Represents a tensor argument with a name.

classes.name: TokenArgument
classes.description: Represents a token argument with a name.

classes.name: SymIntArgument
classes.description: Represents a symbolic integer argument with a name.

classes.name: SymFloatArgument
classes.description: Represents a symbolic float argument with a name.

classes.name: SymBoolArgument
classes.description: Represents a symbolic boolean argument with a name.

classes.name: CustomObjArgument
classes.description: Represents a custom object argument with class FQN and optional fake value.

classes.name: ConstantArgument
classes.description: Represents a constant argument with a value.

classes.name: InputSpec
classes.description: Models the specification of an input, including its kind, argument, target, and persistence.

classes.name: OutputSpec
classes.description: Models the specification of an output, including its kind, argument, and target.

classes.name: ExportBackwardSignature
classes.description: Holds information about gradients to parameters and user inputs, and the loss output for backward computation.

classes.name: ExportGraphSignature
classes.description: Models the input/output signature of an export graph, including methods to access parameters, buffers, user inputs/outputs, and signature transformation.

methods.name: replace_all_uses
methods.description: Replaces all uses of an old name with a new name in the signature's input and output argument names.

methods.name: get_replace_hook
methods.description: Returns a hook function to replace argument names during graph transformations.
